summary: Enova International filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its NC LOC 2024 facility and a new securitization note offering. The Third Amendment increased revolving commitments from $200M to $300M, extended the revolving period and maturity to 2029 and 2030 respectively, and reduced the borrowing rate to SOFR+5.00%. Separately, subsidiary NetCredit Combined Receivables B, LLC priced $300.886M of 2026-A notes (Class A 5.88%, B 7.68%, C 10.64%) backed by consumer loans, closing on August 21, 2026. These are routine debt and securitization transactions, not special situations. Watch for closing conditions and funding mechanics.
